items.caption: This Shang oracle-script-style form of 非 is drawn as two opposed upright shapes with short strokes extending outward. Wang Qingju reads early forms as two people back-to-back, while another account interprets them as wings spread apart; the image alone does not resolve their origin.
items.alt: Black oracle-script-style glyph with two tall, opposed forms and short outward strokes, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: This is the sole supplied candidate and it provides a sourced illustration of an early form while allowing the competing interpretations to remain explicit.

limitations.text: The visible image is a modern vector redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph. Its depicted shape does not establish whether 非 originated as people facing away or as wings; those are competing interpretations.
Early oracle-bone examples already include negative uses, so the evidence does not establish a dated progression from a pictorial sense through opposition to negation.
